Rendered HTML captured from the live Trac renderer (convert_preview, format=tracwiki, /trac_test) on 2026-09-07, per Rules/testing/RealSubstrateNotMocks. Ticket #75 section 5 requires asserting on the rendered HTML, not stored bytes alone, because the defect is a change of document structure -- one
  • becoming an
  • plus a separate

    .

rows.name: item_one_continuation_aligned
rows.tracwiki:
* item one
   continuation of item one
rows.note: Ticket #75 section 2 row 1. Continuation already aligned under the item text in the source; stored bytes are unchanged by the fix and render as one <li>.

rows.name: item_one_continuation_unaligned
rows.note: Ticket #75 section 2 row 2. Source has only a 2-space continuation (not aligned under 'item one'); the fixed write leg normalises it to 3 spaces (aligned under the item text), which still renders as one <li> -- confirmed the source's own 2-space form does too, so the fix's requirement is 'deeper than the marker', not an exact column.

rows.name: one_more_of_one_two
rows.note: Ticket #75 section 2 row 3. A continuation in the middle of a list: before the fix this split into three <li>s around an absorbed paragraph. Fixed output renders as two <li>s, the continuation staying inside the first.

rows.name: ordered_one_more_of_one
rows.note: Ticket #75 section 2 row 4. Same defect in an ordered list.
